settings.question: Which weights fit my [brand] driver?
settings.answer: Use the fit finder at the top of this page — pick your club and model and we'll show you every compatible [brand] weight. Each product page also lists the exact club heads it fits.

settings.question: How many grams should I add to my [brand] clubs?
settings.answer: As a rule of thumb, around 2g of head weight moves swing weight by one point on a driver-length club. Most golfers experiment within the 2g–20g range. Our swing weight guide explains how to find your number.

settings.question: Do I need a special wrench to change [brand] weights?
settings.answer: Yes — [brand] weights are fitted with a torque wrench. If you don't already have one, add a [brand] or universal wrench from the wrench section above to your order.

settings.question: Are these genuine [brand] parts?
settings.answer: These are high-quality aftermarket golf club weights engineered to match the thread and fit of [brand] heads exactly — a cost-effective alternative to manufacturer parts.

settings.question: How quickly will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Orders placed before 1pm are dispatched the same day, and UK delivery is free on orders over £40. See our delivery page for full details.
